snapshot.title: Helpdesk Ticket: Eastfield Zone 2 Water Loss

fields.subject: Complete loss of water and low pressure in Eastfield Zone 2
fields.description: Resident (Eastfield, 2900 Eastfield Boulevard) reports no water and low pressure. Water has been off for over 40 minutes. Calls every 15 minutes. First call at 07:10. Requesting confirmation on whether tap water is safe to use for drinking, cooking, or bathing. The facility is not on bottled water. No visible break on street. Pressure remains below 15 psi. This is a follow-up to CS-2025-0716-001 and CS-2025-0716-002.

activity.author: Customer Service Lead – Renee Dupree
activity.text: Ticket created from incoming call. Confirmed location and pressure status. Added to cluster: 'Zone 2 water loss, multiple reports from Eastfield and Hilltop.'

activity.author: System
activity.text: Ticket assigned to Customer Service – Field Ops. Priority escalated to High due to location in Zone 2 and confirmed pressure drop.

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

snapshot.instructorNote: This ticket confirms a growing cluster of complaints from Eastfield Zone 2. The PIO should now open the media log and begin tracking by street and question type (water safety).
